recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-25266 distinction without changing the StructureMap element model; any future changes to rule-name quoting or broader FML grammar behavior should be raised as separate mapping-language work.
issue_request: FHIR-25266 reported that FML escaped identifiers could produce names invalid for StructureMap id-typed group, rule, and variable fields; the Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution kept id rules for map-defined names, excluded target.context because logical model contexts can be URIs, and required clearer syntax guidance.
initial_application: Commit 9799fa13cb applied the core R5 resolution by changing StructureMap.group.rule.target.context from id to string, adding syntax prose that id values are not backtick-delimited, and updating the then-current grammar. The StructureMap element model still matched the decision, but the later db673c36e8 grammar rewrite drifted by excluding delimited path parts while allowing the broader identifier rule for as-variables and group invocations.
additional_context: FHIR-23033 is a Resolved - No Change predecessor that points to FHIR-25266, and FHIR-25286 separately removed double quotes as an allowed mapping-language delimiter. Build-scope checks confirmed StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini, mapping-language.html is in source/hierarchy.xml, and publish.ini includes both mapping-language.html and mapping.g4.
reconciliation: Changed source/mapping-language.html to say data model path elements may be backtick-delimited, target.context may be a logical-model URI, and map-defined group, rule, and variable names still follow id rules. Changed images/mapping.g4 so qualified rule-path components include DELIMITEDIDENTIFIER while as-variables and group invocations use ID.
source_changes: source/mapping-language.html: clarified that delimited identifiers apply to source/target data model elements in rule paths, while target.context remains the URI-capable exception and map-defined names remain id-constrained.
images/mapping.g4: added DELIMITEDIDENTIFIER to qualified rule-path components and restricted as-variables and group invocations to ID.
